notes.title: Achievements Unlocked for Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry!
notes.content:
[h2]🔓 Achievements Unlocked! 🔓[/h2]
 

It's time to rise up and set sail once more as Steam achievements are now available for Assassin’s Creed Freedom Cry.


[i][b]Achievements will be retroactively earned for those accomplishments already completed in your journey upon launching the game.[/b][/i]
 

Jump back into the action with Adewale and start collecting those awards. 💪
